messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 triggered — Hosted inference API (text-generation + embeddings) showing spike in 5xxs and 95th percentile latency. Alert: INC-2790012345. Affected region: us-west-2. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-2790012345

Lee (oncall): Acked. I’m on it. Pulling up tail and autoscaling events.

Maria Chen: Jumping in as incident owner. Can someone drop the war room link and the most recent deploy ID?

incident-bot: War room created: https://meet.redwood.example/warroom/2790012345. Latest deploy: deploy-2026-11-03-7. Incident page: https://incident.redwood.example/2790012345

Alex R: @Maria Chen thx — infra noted a scaling surge around the time of deploy-2026-11-03-7. Could be autoscale thrash.

Maria Chen: Ok first triage notes:
- Scope: Hosted inference REST endpoints for generation/embeddings in us-west-2.
- Symptoms: 500/503 responses, increased token latency (p95 ~ 2.4s -> 12s).
- Customer impact: some API calls 50% failures for a subset of routes.

Jamal K: Customer impact summary for comms: a handful of customers may see failed requests and timeouts; no evidence of data loss. We should prepare a targeted status page entry and an outbound notification if this persists >30m.

Lee (oncall): Quick mitigation checklist (running):
```
- scale up dedicated GPU pool (temp +2 nodes)
- revert or pin to deploy-2026-11-03-6 if new deploy suspected
- disable non-critical background batch jobs hitting same model endpoint
- enable aggressive KV cache warming for frequent prefixes
```

Maria Chen: Lee, proceed with scale up and hold on revert until we confirm error traces. Dan, can you watch support queue and surface customer-reported errors?

Dan (support): Monitoring. So far CS has two threads mentioning timeouts. Pinging customers for logs and request IDs.

Infra Eng: Noted increased kernel OOMs on node gpu-uw2-07 around 13:02Z, recovered then. We're collecting dmesg + driver logs.

Maria Chen: War room note: owner=Maria Chen, responder=Lee (oncall), infra=Infra Eng, product=Jamal K, support=Dan (support), comms=Izzy - Comms.

Izzy - Comms: Drafting status page blurb — please review: 

```
Redwood Inference is currently investigating elevated error rates and latency for hosted inference in us-west-2. Some API requests for text generation and embeddings may receive 500/503 responses or experience high latency. We are actively mitigating; no evidence of data loss. Updates every 15 minutes.
```

Maria Chen: LGTM. Add ETA to next update: in 15 minutes. Jamal, please prep customer-facing language for top affected accounts if we need to send targeted messages.

Jamal K: Will pull the impacted org list from billing/usage and draft targeted messages. Prefer to wait until we see whether scale-up reduces errors (5–10m).

Lee (oncall): Scale-up complete +2 nodes. Early signs: error rate dropped from 48% -> 22%. Rolling additional cache priming, monitoring CPU/GPU util.

incident-bot: Update posted to incident page. Next automated check scheduled in 10m.

Maria Chen: Good. Action items:
- Lee: continue monitoring and follow up on traces (assigned).
- Infra Eng: upload kernel/driver logs to war room artifacts.
- Jamal: prepare targeted comms if >30m or if errors rebound.
- Izzy: post status page entry and standby for outbound messaging approval.
- Dan: escalate any customer threads with request IDs to war room.

comms-bot: Suggested status page update (short):
"We are investigating increased error rates and latency for inference in us-west-2. Impact: some request failures and timeouts. Mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes."

Maria Chen: Confirming we will not send a broad outbound notification yet — only targeted outreach if top 10 impacted accounts show >30% errors. Acknowledged by all?

Alex R: Ack. If errors drop <10% and remain stable for 10m, we'll move to 'monitoring' and close the P1.

Lee (oncall): Adding final note: trace IDs for samples uploaded to war room artifacts: trace: abc123, def456, ghi789. If you need pb-encoded logs ping me.

Izzy - Comms: Posting status page now and prepping a half-hour update template.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — keep posts tight. I'll run the incident commander loop and call for postmortem if root cause maps to the deploy.

Dan (support): Support queue will hold template responses. Will escalate any angry customers to war room. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 active. War room link pinned in thread.

Maria Chen: Closing channel check-in for now — leaving war room open. Update in 15 minutes or on change.
